# Credits for the icons in this directory

These are **not** covered by `../LICENSE`, which is the MIT text for `file_dialog`'s *code*. The upstream
project credits them separately, in its own `README.md`:

> icons8 - for the 3D Fluency icons - https://icons8.it/icons/3d-fluency

So they are third-party assets by [icons8](https://icons8.com/), from the *3D Fluency* set, under icons8's
terms: https://icons8.com/license

Recorded here, beside the files, rather than only in a README two directories up — an attribution that
travels with the assets is one that survives someone copying the directory.

## What is not settled

**Which icons8 licence these arrived under is unknown to us**, and that has not been read. It matters
because Raven *distributes* them: they are in the wheel, so this is a redistribution question and not only
an attribution one. Anyone doing anything with these beyond leaving them where they are — shipping a
release, upscaling them for the grid view's larger tiles, deriving a new set from them — should read the
terms first. An AI upscale in particular is a derivative work and inherits whatever the original permits.

`TODO_DEFERRED.md`, "A file-type icon set of our own", is the plan that removes the question: a set drawn
from scratch covers the formats these lack and carries no third-party terms.
